name: Sullivan County, PA
findings: Sullivan County has 33 nonprofit organizations. 10 of them (30%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 8 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (86% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Sullivan County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
30% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Social and fraternal organizations stand out for public events
observations.text: 6 social and fraternal organizations here list public events, compared with about 2 in similar places of this size.

confidence.text: Based on 6 organizations here; 54% of all organizations here have no identified type.
